title: Very comfortable pure cotton for summer in Odisha
text: The cloth is 100% pure cotton, super breathable in hot weather. Color did not bleed after first wash. Perfect fitting for size L.

title: Good quality but slightly loose around waist
text: Print is vibrant and exactly as shown. Fabric is dense and non-transparent. Stitching around armholes could be slightly cleaner.

title: Shrunk after machine washing
text: Shrunk nearly one full inch after machine wash. Recommend buying one size larger if you machine wash.

title: Stunning Chanderi look for puja and festivals
text: The maroon color is royal and rich. Flare is graceful and embroidery work on neck gives expensive feel at ₹949.

title: Needs inner lining for comfort
text: Aesthetic is good but fabric can feel itchy without inner lining during humid days. Dry clean recommended.

title: Fabric is too thin and transparent under direct light
text: At 599 you get what you pay for. Looks nice on model but very thin rayon fabric. Definitely needs a slip underneath.

title: Decent for daily home wear
text: Pockets are very useful. Soft material for casual home use. Color stayed after couple washes.

title: Authentic Khadi feel, great office wear
text: Superb texture. Doesn't crush easily like thin cotton. Colleagues asked where I bought it.

title: Bright cheerful yellow, decent collar finish
text: Good formal look with collar. Needs gentle iron. Price of 749 is fair for the quality.

title: Color faded on collar after first rinse
text: Cheap dye quality. Disappointed with durability even though price was under 500.

title: Mulmul cotton is heavenly in heat
text: Incredibly soft and lightweight. Color is subtle pastel blue. High quality stitching.

title: Odisha ikat pattern is very well executed
text: Very proud to wear local artisan inspired motifs. Fits true to size chart.
